title: Solar Component Identification
summary: Find and show each component of a small solar lighting kit to the camera.

steps.title: Solar panel
steps.description: Photovoltaic module that converts sunlight into DC electricity. Look for the cell grid and the junction box on the back.
instructions: Show the front of the panel.
Turn it to show the junction box and its rating label.

steps.title: Battery
steps.description: Stores energy for night-time use. Read the voltage and Ah rating on the label.
instructions: Show the battery label to the camera.

criteria.description: battery with readable voltage/Ah label shown

steps.title: Charge controller
steps.description: Regulates charging and protects the battery. Has three terminal pairs: PV, BAT and LOAD.
instructions: Show the controller face with the three terminal pairs.

criteria.description: charge controller with PV, BAT and LOAD terminals visible

steps.title: LED lamp
steps.description: 12 V DC LED load. Note the + and − leads.
instructions: Show the lamp and its two leads.

steps.title: Inline fuse
steps.description: Protects the battery cable from short-circuit current. Fitted on the positive cable close to the battery.
instructions: Open the fuse holder and show the fuse rating.

criteria.description: inline fuse and its rating shown

steps.title: Cables
steps.description: Red is positive, black is negative. Cable size must match the current.
instructions: Show one red and one black cable.

steps.title: MC4 connectors
steps.description: Weatherproof panel connectors. Male and female halves lock together.
instructions: Show a male and a female MC4 connector.

criteria.description: male and female MC4 connectors shown
